no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to an advisory committee meeting as the product is not the first in its class and as no major safety concerns were found during our review that would bring into question the approvability of the product based on its risk:benefit profile.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for SAVELLA (milnacipran) NDA022256. The Summary Review states the application was not presented to an AdComm because the product is not first-in-class and no major safety concerns challenged its risk:benefit profile, and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader memo independently confirms that although milnacipran is a new molecular entity, no AdComm was held because it is not the first drug in the norepinephrine-serotonin reuptake inhibitor (NSRI) class. With no committee meeting, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
